script: A king once survived a gun with twenty five barrels fired directly at him, and eighteen people around him did not. In July 1835, King Louis Philippe of France rode down a Paris boulevard with his sons and officers, celebrating an anniversary of the revolution. Hidden in a nearby window, a man named Giuseppe Fieschi had built a custom weapon, twenty five gun barrels bundled together to fire at once like a volley of cannon fire. When the king's procession passed below, Fieschi fired every barrel in a single deafening blast. Nearly four hundred bullets tore through the crowd. Officers standing beside the king were killed instantly. The king himself was hit by nothing more than a scratch across his forehead. Fieschi was captured, tried, and executed within months. A king once survived a gun built with twenty five barrels, and walked away with barely a mark.

title: How Did the King Survive a Gun With 25 Barrels Fired at Him?
description:
In 1835, Giuseppe Fieschi built a 25-barrel volley gun to assassinate King Louis Philippe of France. The blast killed 18 people nearby. The king survived with only a scratch.

Would that scratch have been enough to make you quit being king, or keep going? Let me know in the comments.
